decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform is the core of the firm's established offer, received a page of its own in 2019, and carries heavy investment and public commitment, so dropping it would write off central resources and contradict the announced strategic direction.

The mobile field data capture software has been presented on a page of its own since launch, is close to the core business, and fits the firm's mobile and enterprise integration direction, so the visible commitment favours keeping it even if uptake has been modest.

The search extension was still being actively versioned and publicly announced in 2019 and is tied to the firm's flagship web map platform, so continued investment and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
